summary: Through-road kerb with no parked cars and No Stopping signs.
reasons: Four No Stopping Any Time signs
Gym and townhouses right beside kerb

drivers.seclusion: Kerb runs past a gym 8 m away and townhouses; bush behind them. Homes across the road at about 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb-side strip is narrow, with a footpath and fence; no pull-off apart from the signed kerb.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with two lanes each way, marked centre line and steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at 1.3, 11, 12.2 and 12.8 m from the kerb line
Low-lying: about 5-6.7 m elevation, Witton Creek 41 m away
sun_shade: Open along the kerb, with scattered street trees and bush to the north-west.
cannot_judge: Exact sign coverage along the kerb
